name: Jack Della Maddalena

official.source: data/derived/fighters.json (ufcstats: 71 in, 73 in reach, stance listed as Switch)

face.shape: Broad, square-to-rectangular face, wide at the cheekbones and jaw with little taper to the chin; the forehead is broad. From the front the head reads wide for its height, and the protruding ears add to the width.
face.jaw: Wide with fairly square angles under the short beard; the jaw line runs almost straight into a thick neck.
face.chin: Broad and moderately projecting under the beard; in left profile (Montreal) the beard front sits a little ahead of the lower lip.
face.cheekbones: Broad but not sharply defined; cheeks flat to moderately full, freckled.
face.brow_ridge: Moderately prominent; the eyes look small and slightly deep-set beneath it.
face.forehead: Broad and medium-tall, smooth with faint horizontal lines. The hairline recedes a little at the temples.

eyes.shape: Smallish almond eyes with hooded upper lids; outer corners level to slightly down; mild bags beneath.
eyes.colour: Light hazel-green: olive-green with brown around the pupil (consistent in the 2026 and 2025 studio portraits and the 2025 weigh-in). Closest embed iris: green (brownlight as the alternative).

eyebrows.shape: Straight and low, close to the eyes, with slightly drooping outer tails that fade out; lower contrast than the beard.

nose.width: Medium, with a slightly broad bridge.
nose.hump: None; the left profile (Montreal) shows a straight line.
nose.tip: Rounded and medium-broad, roughly horizontal (neither drooping nor upturned).

mouth.upper_lip: Thin, partly under the moustache, with a flat cupid's bow.
mouth.resting_expression: Closed, a flat line with the corners slightly down.

ears.protrusion: Strongly protruding: both ears stand well out from the head in every frontal photo, a key recognition cue with the faded sides.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes, moderate on the right: the right concha looks filled and lumpy with blurred folds (April 2026 stance, May 2025 weigh-in). The left ear has a thick rim and milder thickening.
ears.notes: Model large, stand-out ears with extra depth, more on the right.

face.notable_marks_scars: Many small freckles over the forehead, cheeks and nose; a small reddish spot on the left cheek beside the nose (April 2026 headshot). The cut beside the right eye in the UFC Perth photo is a fight injury, not permanent.

hair.style: Short textured crop: about 3-4 cm on top, pushed up and forward loosely, with the sides and back faded short (low fade, about 0.5-1 cm). No part, no fringe.
hair.colour: Medium auburn-brown, clearly browner and darker than the copper beard; golden-auburn where lit.
hair.hairline: Slightly receding at both temples, with a small rounded forelock in the centre; dense on top.
hair.texture: Fine to medium, wavy, a little curly at the ends.

facial_hair.colour: Copper-ginger red, brighter and redder than the head hair; this colour split is a strong cue.
facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin, moustache and jaw; lower density high on the cheeks, where skin shows through.
facial_hair.length_mm: 10-15 mm in April-May 2026, about 15-20 mm at the chin in May 2025.
facial_hair.shape: Full short beard joined to the moustache. Natural low cheek line from the sideburn diagonally down to the mouth corners; rounded at the chin; neckline on the upper neck under the jaw.

skin.tone_hex_method: plain RGB mean of the three studio cheek samples marked in_average; each sample is the median of a small well-lit patch
skin.tone_hex_recommended_method: 60% face average + 40% torso average (ESPN studio light)
skin.undertone: Fair and warm-pink (ruddy), redder on the cheeks, nose, ears and shoulders; pinker than Belal Muhammad's olive-golden skin under the same light.
skin.freckles_marks: Many small light-brown freckles on the face, shoulders, chest and arms; light ginger body hair on the forearms and legs.

body.build: Athletic, medium frame; compact and muscular for welterweight. Reach (73 in) is 2 in more than his height.
body.body_fat_notes: Clear six-pack, serratus and oblique lines in the April 2026 studio stance; similar in May 2025.
body.shoulders: Broad, with round, full deltoids and thick traps.
body.chest: Full, well-developed pecs with a clear lower edge.
body.arms: Muscular upper arms and strong forearms, freckled, with light ginger hair. Not bodybuilder-sized.
body.legs_calves: Muscular thighs with clear quad separation, medium calves, light ginger leg hair.
body.neck: Thick; from the front almost as wide as the jaw.
body.posture: Upright and square, shoulders relaxed, chin slightly down.
body.notable_physique_traits: Freckled fair skin, thick neck and traps, full chest, protruding ears; reads stocky-athletic rather than rangy.

tattoos_note: None visible on the face, neck, chest, abdomen, arms or legs in the 2025 and 2026 studio stances, the May 2025 weigh-in or the May 2026 fight photo. His back is not seen in any of these photos.
accessories_seen: Camo-print baseball cap at the Montreal face-off (May 2025).

kit.typical_shorts: April 2026 studio portrait: green UFC shorts with white and dark-green tiger-stripe slashes, black waistband with a white UFC wordmark, crypto.com logo low on his RIGHT thigh (viewer's left). May 2025 studio: the same green tiger-stripe kit with DELLA MADDALENA in yellow-gold capitals down his LEFT leg. UFC Perth (May 2026, red corner): green UFC shorts with a tonal leaf print, a white block pattern at the waistband sides, UFC wordmarks and yellow lettering on his left leg.
kit.gloves: Black UFC 4 oz gloves in studio; red cuffs at UFC Perth (red corner).

morphs_extra._note: Targets from assets/embed/mh-shapes-x.bin.gz (read by src/avatar3d.js). l- = the fighter's own left. Large, strongly protruding ears are a key cue; extra depth stands in for the cauliflower thickening, right more than left.

ethnicity_fit.basis: Fitted by eye to how MakeHuman's three shape bases reproduce what the photos show: small, hooded, slightly deep-set eyes with no inner-corner fold under a moderate brow, a straight medium-height bridge, a thin upper lip and a broad, square face. Not assigned from name, nationality or heritage.
ethnicity_fit.confidence: low: check a render against the April 2026 headshot; the detail morphs work without this block

render_hints.iris: green (light hazel-green; brownlight is the alternative)
render_hints.skin_base: young_caucasian_male (swatch #e6b393) tinted toward tone_hex_recommended #e89d80, with freckles and a pink flush on the cheeks, nose, ears and shoulders. Texture picked by age and swatch colour only.
render_hints.eyebrows: eyebrow001 (the thinner one) tinted #8c5a40, low and straight
render_hints.hair: strand shell about 3-4 cm textured top with a low fade, tinted #64412f
render_hints.beard: short beard shell 10-15 mm tinted #7f4630, clearly redder than the hair

notes: Confidence: high for hair and beard colours, freckled fair skin, eye colour, ears and build; medium for face proportions; low-to-medium for exact morph values. 7 photos, all reference-only: Wikimedia Commons has no photo of him (Commons search and the English Wikipedia article checked Nov 6, 2026), so nothing here is embed-ok. 3 are from 2026 (April 2026 studio headshot and stance, May 2026 fight and ceremonial weigh-in). One true left profile (May 2025, under a cap) and no right profile. What to watch: (1) The likeness rests on the broad, square face, the copper-red short beard that is redder than the auburn-brown hair, the freckled ruddy skin and the large stand-out ears. (2) Keep the eyes small and hooded under low, light brows; default eyes look too open. (3) Hair is a short textured top with faded sides and slightly receding temples, not a long proxy. (4) Body: compact and muscular with a thick neck and full chest; do not make him rangy. (5) His stance is listed as Switch on ufcstats. Macro values: ageOldM uses MakeHuman's 25-years-at-0.5, 90-years-at-1.0 mapping (age 30). heightUpM 0.1 matches other 180.3 cm fighters. l-/r- morphs are the character's own left and right.
